note: Survey, facility and measurement for observational sources, drafted from the titles and abstracts of the cited papers and background knowledge; entries have not been checked against each paper. Sources not listed have no entry yet (shown blank on the page): open the cited paper. Where the compilation used by sim-highline stores a citation that does not match the source label, the page says so.

Tremonti et al. 2004 (SDSS).measures: Gas-phase oxygen abundance of about 53,000 star-forming galaxies at z~0.1, from emission lines modelled with photoionisation models.

Andrews & Martini 2013 (SDSS).measures: Direct (Te) oxygen abundances from stacked SDSS spectra in stellar-mass bins.

Curti et al. 2020.measures: Mass-metallicity and fundamental metallicity relations for SDSS galaxies on a Te-based abundance scale.

Gallazzi et al. 2005 (SDSS).measures: Stellar metallicities and light-weighted ages for 175,128 galaxies from absorption-line fits.

Baldry et al. 2012 (GAMA).measures: Low-redshift galaxy stellar mass function from 5,210 galaxies, density-corrected maximum-volume method.

Bauer et al. 2013 (GAMA).measures: Specific star-formation rates of GAMA galaxies.

Wright et al. 2017 (GAMA-II).measures: Galaxy stellar mass function from GAMA-II.

Catinella et al. 2018 (xGASS).facility: Arecibo HI, IRAM 30 m CO, GALEX and SDSS
Catinella et al. 2018 (xGASS).measures: Stellar-mass-selected census of HI (and total cold gas) fractions of 1,179 galaxies at 0.01<z<0.05.

Saintonge et al. 2017 (xCOLD GASS).measures: Molecular gas fractions of stellar-mass-selected nearby galaxies.

SPARC / Lelli et al. 2019.facility: SPARC: HI and Hα rotation curves with Spitzer 3.6 μm photometry

Kormendy & Ho 2013.measures: Black-hole mass versus velocity dispersion and bulge properties.

McConnell & Ma 2013.measures: Black-hole mass versus bulge and total stellar mass and velocity dispersion.

Reines & Volonteri 2015.facility: SDSS broad-line AGN with virial masses, plus dynamical masses
Reines & Volonteri 2015.measures: Black-hole mass versus total stellar mass for 341 galaxies at z<0.055.

Kirby et al. 2013 (Local Group dwarfs).measures: Stellar mass-stellar metallicity relation of dwarf irregular and spheroidal galaxies.

Speagle et al. 2014.facility: 25 literature studies on a common calibration

Popesso et al. 2023.facility: Literature census on a common calibration
Popesso et al. 2023.measures: Star-forming main sequence to z~6 with curvature at high mass.

Behroozi et al. 2013.facility: Abundance matching constrained by observed mass functions
Behroozi et al. 2013.measures: Stellar-to-halo mass relation (a model, not a direct measurement).

Behroozi et al. 2019 (UniverseMachine).facility: Constrained by stellar mass functions, SFRs, quenched fractions, UV luminosity functions and clustering
Behroozi et al. 2019 (UniverseMachine).measures: Stellar-to-halo mass relation and quenched fractions to z~10 (a model, not a direct measurement).

Moster et al. 2013.facility: Abundance matching constrained by observed mass functions
Moster et al. 2013.measures: Stellar-to-halo mass relation (a model, not a direct measurement).

COSMOS-Web 2025.measures: Galaxy stellar mass function in 15 redshift bins.

Koprowski et al. (COSMOS-Web MS).measures: Quiescent fractions and star-forming main sequence.

Curti et al. 2024 (JADES).measures: Mass-metallicity relation at z=3-6, as compiled in the COLIBRE data release repository.

Lam et al. 2026 (JADES stacks).measures: Mass-metallicity relation, as compiled in the COLIBRE data release repository.

Nakajima et al. 2023 (ERO/GLASS/CEERS).measures: Mass-metallicity relation at z~4-10, as compiled in the COLIBRE data release repository.

He et al. 2026 (NGDEEP).measures: Mass-metallicity relation, as compiled in the COLIBRE data release repository.

Ilbert et al. 2013.measures: Stellar mass functions of star-forming and quiescent galaxies to z~4.

Grazian et al. 2015.facility: HST + Spitzer, CANDELS (UDS, GOODS-S) and HUDF

van der Wel et al. 2014.measures: Galaxy size-mass relations of early- and late-type galaxies at 0<z<3.

Moustakas et al. 2013 (SDSS).facility: SDSS (local part of a larger SDSS and PRIMUS analysis)

Eckert et al. 2016 (XXL).measures: Gas fractions of groups and clusters.

Bouwens et al. 2015 (UV-derived).measures: UV-derived star-formation rate function at z~4-8.

Smit et al. 2012 (UV-derived).measures: UV-derived star-formation rate function at z~4-7.

vanderBurg2010.measures: UV luminosity function of Lyman-break galaxies at z~3-4.

Alavi et al. 2016.measures: Faint UV luminosity function at z~2.

Bouwens et al. 2021.facility: HST legacy imaging (HUDF, Frontier Field parallels, CANDELS)
Bouwens et al. 2021.measures: Rest-frame UV luminosity function of dropout galaxies at z~2-10, stepwise estimate.

Harikane et al. 2023.facility: JWST/NIRCam early release (ERO and ERS) imaging
Harikane et al. 2023.measures: UV luminosity function of dropout candidates at z~9-16, binned.

Bouwens et al. 2021 (Schechter fit).facility: HST legacy imaging (HUDF, Frontier Field parallels, CANDELS)
Bouwens et al. 2021 (Schechter fit).measures: Rest-frame UV luminosity function of dropout galaxies at z~2-10, as Schechter fits.

Harikane et al. 2023 (Schechter fit).facility: JWST/NIRCam early release (ERO and ERS) imaging
Harikane et al. 2023 (Schechter fit).measures: UV luminosity function of dropout candidates at z~9-16, as Schechter fits.

Harikane et al. 2023 (UV only).facility: JWST/NIRCam early release (ERO and ERS) imaging
Harikane et al. 2023 (UV only).measures: Cosmic SFR density at z~9-16 from the UV luminosity function without dust correction.

Donnan et al. 2024.measures: UV luminosity function at z=9-14.5 from about 370 arcmin^2.

Madau & Dickinson 2014.facility: Compilation of UV and infrared surveys (review)
Madau & Dickinson 2014.measures: Best-fitting cosmic SFR density versus redshift, z 0-8, Salpeter IMF.

Avila-Reese et al. 2008.facility: Compiled sample of 76 normal, non-interacting disc galaxies (high and low surface brightness)
Avila-Reese et al. 2008.measures: Scaling relations of disc galaxies (rotation velocity with luminosity, stellar and baryonic mass) in several bands; here the stellar Tully-Fisher fit.

Beeston et al. 2018 (H-ATLAS/GAMA).facility: Herschel-ATLAS with GAMA (as labelled in the compilation)
Beeston et al. 2018 (H-ATLAS/GAMA).measures: Dust mass function at low redshift.

Bocquet et al. 2016.measures: Halo mass function with baryonic effects, fitted to Magneticum; a theory comparison curve, not an observation.

Bradford et al. 2015.facility: Observed cold gas fractions, fit as reproduced in Stinson et al. 2015 (Fig. 1)
Bradford et al. 2015.measures: Cold gas fraction of galaxies versus stellar mass, as a fit.

Deshmukh et al. 2018.facility: Spitzer Matching survey of the UltraVISTA Ultra-deep Stripes (SMUVS), about 66,000 sources at z=2-6
Deshmukh et al. 2018.measures: Galaxy stellar mass function split into dusty, non-dusty and passive galaxies.

JWST+ground MZR compilation (Sharda+26 r.facility: Individual-galaxy tables from JWST and ground-based spectroscopy, compiled in the Sharda et al. 2026 repository
JWST+ground MZR compilation (Sharda+26 r.measures: Gas-phase oxygen abundance versus stellar mass at z>3 as compiled for the COLIBRE comparison.

Lee et al. 2006 (dwarfs).measures: Mass-metallicity relation extended by 2.5 decades in stellar mass to dwarf galaxies.

Lin et al. 2012.facility: Massive galaxy clusters at z<0.25 (this record), from the paper's z=0-0.6 sample
Lin et al. 2012.measures: Baryon content (gas fraction) of massive clusters.

Mosleh et al. 2020.facility: HST imaging, stellar mass maps from pixel-by-pixel SED fitting of about 5,500 galaxies at z up to 2
Mosleh et al. 2020.measures: Galaxy sizes from the stellar mass distribution (radii enclosing 20, 50 and 80 per cent of the mass).

Parsa et al. 2016.facility: Deep multi-band imaging of the UV luminosity function at z about 2-4
Parsa et al. 2016.measures: UV-derived star formation rate function at z about 2-4 (from the paper's UV luminosity function).

Pozzi et al. 2020.facility: Herschel far-infrared surveys (as in the paper)
Pozzi et al. 2020.measures: Dust mass function from z about 0 to 2.5.

Read et al. 2017.facility: Isolated field dwarf galaxies with rotation-curve halo masses (as labelled in the compilation)
Read et al. 2017.measures: Stellar-to-halo mass relation at the dwarf-galaxy end.

Remy-Ruyer et al. 2014.facility: Herschel Dwarf Galaxy Survey, KINGFISH and a subsample of Galametz et al. 2011 (126 galaxies)
Remy-Ruyer et al. 2014.measures: Gas-to-dust mass ratio versus metallicity over a 2 dex range.

Reyes et al. 2011.facility: Calibrated Tully-Fisher relations from disc rotation velocities (fit)
Reyes et al. 2011.measures: Stellar Tully-Fisher relation between stellar mass and calibrated rotation velocity.

Sahu et al. 2019.facility: Dynamical black hole masses of early-type galaxies (fit)
Sahu et al. 2019.measures: Black hole mass scaling relations with spheroid and galaxy stellar mass and velocity dispersion.

Stott et al. 2013.measures: Galaxy sizes of H-alpha emitters across the peak epoch of star formation (Table 1).

Tinker et al. 2008 (colossus, Planck13).facility: Collisionless cosmological N-body simulations, evaluated with colossus for Planck 2013 cosmology
Tinker et al. 2008 (colossus, Planck13).measures: Halo mass function fitting formula; a theory comparison curve, not an observation.

Zahid et al. 2014.facility: Emission-line metallicities of star-forming galaxies at z up to 1.6 (see paper)
Zahid et al. 2014.measures: Mass-metallicity relation with a characteristic turnover mass that evolves with redshift.

xGASS (Catinella et al. 2018).facility: xGASS Arecibo HI survey, via the velociraptor comparison data
xGASS (Catinella et al. 2018).measures: Size relation as provided by the compilation (the upstream citation read 'in prep').

Whitaker et al. 2014 (3D-HST/CANDELS).facility: 3D-HST (HST WFC3 grism) and CANDELS imaging, with Spitzer/MIPS 24 micron for the infrared
Whitaker et al. 2014 (3D-HST/CANDELS).measures: Star-forming sequence at 0.5 < z < 2.5 from median stacks of star-forming galaxies; SFR from UV plus infrared luminosity, stellar masses from SED fits.

Schreiber et al. 2015 (Herschel stacking.facility: Herschel far-infrared stacking with UV, in the GOODS, CANDELS and COSMOS fields
Schreiber et al. 2015 (Herschel stacking.measures: Main sequence of star formation at 0.3 < z < 5 as the mode of the SFR distribution, from stacks of galaxies that are not UVJ-quiescent.

Leja et al. 2022 (COSMOS-2015 + 3D-HST,.facility: COSMOS-2015 (0.2 < z < 0.8) and 3D-HST (0.5 < z < 3.0) galaxy catalogues, SED fitting with Prospector-alpha
Leja et al. 2022 (COSMOS-2015 + 3D-HST,.measures: Ridge and mean of the SFR distribution at fixed stellar mass, with no star-forming selection; SFRs averaged over 100 Myr from non-parametric star formation histories.

Tomczak et al. 2016 (ZFOURGE).facility: ZFOURGE near-infrared medium-band catalogues, with stacked 24 to 160 micron photometry
Tomczak et al. 2016 (ZFOURGE).measures: SFR against stellar mass of all galaxies and of UVJ star-forming galaxies from stacked UV plus infrared SFRs at 0.5 < z < 4.

Lee et al. 2015 (COSMOS, Herschel/Spitze.facility: COSMOS field with Herschel and Spitzer infrared luminosities and the NRK colour method
Lee et al. 2015 (COSMOS, Herschel/Spitze.measures: Median SFR against stellar mass of star-forming galaxies at 0.25 < z < 1.3, fitted with a turnover at high mass.

Iyer et al. 2018 (CANDELS GOODS-S, Dense.facility: CANDELS GOODS-S photometry, SED fitting with Dense Basis non-parametric star formation histories
Iyer et al. 2018 (CANDELS GOODS-S, Dense.measures: SFR against stellar mass at 1 < z < 6 down to low masses, with instantaneous SFRs from the SED fits.

Salim, Boquien & Lee 2018 (GSWLC-2).facility: SDSS spectroscopy with GALEX ultraviolet and WISE mid-infrared photometry (GALEX-SDSS-WISE Legacy Catalog 2)
Salim, Boquien & Lee 2018 (GSWLC-2).measures: SED-fitted stellar masses and SFRs (averaged over 100 Myr) of about 360,000 galaxies at 0.01 < z < 0.30, the joint distribution of specific SFR and mass.

Barro et al. 2017 (CANDELS GOODS-S).facility: HST CANDELS imaging in GOODS-South with mass profiles from multi-band photometry
Barro et al. 2017 (CANDELS GOODS-S).measures: Stellar mass surface density within 1 kpc (Sigma_1) of star-forming and quiescent galaxies at 0.5 < z < 3.

Fang et al. 2013 (SDSS).facility: SDSS imaging (i-band mass profiles) of central galaxies
Fang et al. 2013 (SDSS).measures: Stellar mass surface density within 1 kpc against stellar mass for central green-valley and red-sequence galaxies at z ~ 0.

Zahid et al. 2016 (SDSS).measures: Central stellar velocity dispersion against stellar mass for quiescent galaxies (Dn4000 > 1.5), corrected to a fixed 3 kpc aperture.

Zahid et al. 2016 (SHELS).measures: Central stellar velocity dispersion against stellar mass for quiescent galaxies (Dn4000 > 1.5), corrected to a fixed 3 kpc aperture.

Aird et al. 2015.facility: Chandra and XMM-Newton deep X-ray surveys, 2-10 keV luminosity function
Aird et al. 2015.measures: Supermassive black hole accretion rate density over cosmic time from the AGN X-ray luminosity function, across the full range of absorption including Compton-thick, with a bolometric correction.

Veale et al. 2017 (MASSIVE+ATLAS3D).facility: MASSIVE survey and ATLAS3D integral-field spectroscopy of early-type galaxies
Veale et al. 2017 (MASSIVE+ATLAS3D).measures: Fraction of slow rotators and mean spin parameter within the effective radius against stellar mass for early-type galaxies.

Hopkins et al. 2007.facility: Optical, infrared and X-ray quasar and AGN luminosity function surveys combined with a bolometric correction model
Hopkins et al. 2007.measures: Bolometric AGN luminosity function and the black hole accretion history, corrected for obscuration, to z ~ 6.

Shen et al. 2020.facility: Compilation of quasar luminosity function measurements with a global model fit
Shen et al. 2020.measures: Bolometric quasar luminosity function including obscured AGN and the resulting black hole accretion history and mass density, z = 0 to 7.

Kennicutt 1998.facility: Disk-averaged H-alpha and far-infrared star formation rates and gas masses of normal spirals and infrared-selected starbursts from the literature
Kennicutt 1998.measures: Global Schmidt law: star formation rate surface density against total gas surface density.

Bigiel et al. 2008.facility: THINGS (HI) and HERACLES (CO) maps with GALEX FUV and Spitzer 24 micron, sampled at 750 pc
Bigiel et al. 2008.measures: Resolved star formation law: star formation rate surface density against molecular gas surface density in nearby spiral galaxies.

Mannucci et al. 2010.facility: SDSS DR7 spectroscopy of emission-line galaxies at 0.07 < z < 0.30
Mannucci et al. 2010.measures: Fundamental metallicity relation: gas-phase oxygen abundance as a function of stellar mass and star formation rate, fitted as a function of mu = log M* - 0.32 log SFR.

Andrews & Martini 2013.facility: Stacked SDSS spectra with direct-method (electron temperature) metallicities
Andrews & Martini 2013.measures: Gas-phase oxygen abundance in bins of stellar mass and star formation rate, from which a fundamental-metallicity projection is read.

Sanders et al. 2021.facility: Stacked SDSS spectra and dwarf galaxies with metallicity calibrations anchored to direct-method abundances
Sanders et al. 2021.measures: Fundamental metallicity relation at z ~ 0 as a cubic function of mu = log M* - 0.60 log SFR.

Sobral et al. 2013 (HiZELS).facility: HiZELS narrow-band imaging (UKIRT WFCAM, Subaru Suprime-Cam, VLT HAWK-I), COSMOS and UDS, about 2 deg2
Sobral et al. 2013 (HiZELS).measures: H-alpha luminosity function at z = 0.40, 0.84, 1.47 and 2.23 from narrow-band emitters, corrected for [NII] and for 1 mag of extinction.

Covelo-Paz et al. 2025 (FRESCO, CONGRESS.facility: JWST NIRCam grism (FRESCO F444W and CONGRESS F356W), GOODS-North and GOODS-South
Covelo-Paz et al. 2025 (FRESCO, CONGRESS.measures: Observed H-alpha luminosity function at z about 4.45, 5.3 and 6.15 from 1050 spectroscopically confirmed emitters.
